title: Universal Life Insurance Interest Convention: Accrual Periods for Settled Loan Interest
content:
When loan interest on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is settled, the days of settlement interest are counted from the loan activity dated after the loan interest paid-to date. The loan balance here is the loan balance standing in the activity history (loan advances plus interest capitalized less principal repaid); the "balance rate" is the rate charged on the loan balance carried from the paid-to date, and the "advance rate" is the rate charged on the most recent loan advance. Interest in every case is simple, for actual calendar days over 365, up to the settlement date.

## Convention

| Loan activity in the activity history | How the settlement interest accrues |
|---|---|
| The most recent loan advance entry is dated after the paid-to date | That advance accrues at the advance rate from its own advance date; the rest of the balance (the balance less that advance) accrues at the balance rate from the paid-to date |
| The most recent loan advance entry is dated on or before the paid-to date, and the most recent loan repayment entry is dated after it | The balance plus the principal that repayment repaid accrues at the balance rate from the paid-to date, and the repaid amount stops accruing on its repayment date |
| Neither the most recent advance nor the most recent repayment is dated after the paid-to date | The whole balance accrues at the balance rate from the paid-to date |

The first row governs whenever the most recent advance is dated after the paid-to date, whatever the repayments show. An entry dated on the paid-to date itself is not dated after it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; balance rate 3%, advance rate 4%, paid-to date 1 March, settlement date 30 July, 151 days)

**Advance after the paid-to date.** Balance $50000.00, of which the most recent advance of $10000.00 is dated 1 May (90 days before settlement). The rest of the balance, $40000.00, at 3% for 151 days is $496.4384; the advance at 4% for 90 days is $98.6301. Accrued interest $595.0685.

**Repayment after the paid-to date, no later advance.** Balance $50000.00 after a repayment of $8000.00 of principal on 1 June (59 days before settlement). $58000.00 at 3% for 151 days is $719.8356, less $8000.00 at 3% for 59 days, $38.7945, which is $681.0411: the repaid $8000.00 accrued only from 1 March to 1 June.

**No loan activity after the paid-to date.** Balance $50000.00 at 3% for 151 days: $620.5479.

These figures are carried unrounded; the settlement interest is rounded to the cent once, at the end.
